title: The Most Unwanted Song (FULL VERSION)
summary: The 1997 novelty song by Komar and Melamid with composer Dave Soldier, built from survey results on what listeners dislike most in music. It features bagpipes, an opera singer rapping, and a children's choir urging shopping at Wal-Mart.
why: Cited in threads about taste and terrible music as a famously engineered 'worst song', mostly for its curiosity value.

quote.text: They surveyed people to find the things they liked least in music and put it all together.
